reviews.name: Sarah J.
reviews.body: Had a leaky pipe on a Saturday morning and Kerr Plumbing was out within a few hours. Fixed it perfectly and explained everything clearly.

reviews.name: Mark D.
reviews.body: Called Kerr to replace an old water heater. They were prompt, clean, and the new unit works great. Very happy with the service.

reviews.body: Our office sink was completely clogged. Kerr Plumbing got it cleared quickly without disrupting our workday. Professional and efficient.
